description: COACTUPC's US state-code edit and its state-plus-first-two-of-zip cross-field companion on a post-fetch REENTER turn - the case that owns the two CSLKPCDY lookups 1270-EDIT-US-STATE-CD and 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD consult, and that pins the ordering fact which makes their two failures mutually exclusive. THE TWO TABLES, RE-DERIVED RATHER THAN TAKEN ON TRUST. COPY CSLKPCDY at app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:602 - COACTUPC is that copybook's only consumer - brings in five independent 88-level lists, and the two this case is about are not phone lookups at all. 01 US-STATE-CODE-TO-EDIT PIC X(2) at app/cpy/CSLKPCDY.cpy:1012 carries 88 VALID-US-STATE-CODE with exactly 56 literals at :1013-1069, including the territories AS, GU, MP, PR and VI and the district DC. The group 01 US-STATE-ZIPCODE-TO-EDIT at :1071 splits into 02 US-STATE-AND-FIRST-ZIP2 PIC X(4) at :1072, which carries 88 VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO with exactly 240 literals at :1073-1313 running AA34 through WY83, and 02 LAST-3-OF-ZIP PIC X(3) at :1314, which exists but is never consulted by the edit because the probe is only four characters wide. Membership for every expected value below was re-derived by extracting those two literal ranges and testing them, not by trusting a summary: ME and NC ARE in the 56-set while AP, FM, MH and PW are NOT; ME49, AP96, NC27 and NC28 ARE in the 240-set while NC12, FM56 and MH72 are NOT; ME39 through ME49 are the Maine entries, NC27 and NC28 the North Carolina entries, and AP96 is the ONLY AP entry in the whole combo table. The phone lookups of the same copybook - VALID-PHONE-AREA-CODE with 490 literals at :30-520, VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE with 410 at :521-930 and VALID-EASY-RECOG-AREA-CODE with 80 at :931-1010 - belong to case11 and appear here only as the passing edits they happen to be for this seed (practice B1). WHAT EACH PARAGRAPH DOES, TAKEN FROM THE SOURCE AND NOT PARAPHRASED. 1270-EDIT-US-STATE-CD :2493-2511 MOVEs ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD into US-STATE-CODE-TO-EDIT and asks IF VALID-US-STATE-CODE; on failure it SETs INPUT-ERROR and FLG-STATE-NOT-OK - ONE field flag - and, guarded by IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF, STRINGs FUNCTION TRIM(WS-EDIT-VARIABLE-NAME) against the literal ': is not a valid state code' taken verbatim from :2503, then GO TO its -EXIT. WS-EDIT-VARIABLE-NAME holds 'State' from :1592, so the composed message is the 32-character 'State: is not a valid state code' and nothing else. 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD :2536-2560, which the source itself calls a crude edit at :2535 - 'A crude zip code edit based on data from USPS web site' - STRINGs ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD against ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-ZIP(1:2) into US-STATE-AND-FIRST-ZIP2 and asks IF VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO; on failure it SETs INPUT-ERROR, FLG-STATE-NOT-OK AND FLG-ZIPCODE-NOT-OK - BOTH field flags, so a combo failure reddens the state and the zip together - and writes the bare literal 'Invalid zip code for state' from :2550, 26 characters with no variable-name prefix. The probe is built from the state code plus the FIRST TWO zip characters only; the remaining three characters sit in LAST-3-OF-ZIP and are never examined. THE CROSS-FIELD GATE IS THE ORDERING FACT THIS CASE EXISTS TO PIN (gate G30, rule R7). The state is edited at :1592-1602 - 1225-EDIT-ALPHA-REQD over a two-character field, then IF FLG-ALPHA-ISVALID PERFORM 1270 - and the zip at :1605-1611 by 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD with WS-EDIT-ALPHANUM-LENGTH 5. Only afterwards, at :1664-1669 under the comment 'Cross field edits begin here', does IF FLG-STATE-ISVALID AND FLG-ZIPCODE-ISVALID PERFORM 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD THRU 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD-EXIT. The combo edit therefore runs ONLY when both single-field edits have already passed, so an invalid state code SUPPRESSES the combo edit entirely and the two failures can never both be reported in one turn. This case drives the suppressing branch; case11 drives the suppressed-nothing branch where the state passed and the combo failed. THE SEED IS THE FIXTURE'S OWN DATA AND IT CARRIES AN INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY BETWEEN THE TWO TABLES. Customer 000000018 of app/data/ASCII/custdata.txt - row index 17 - holds CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD 'AP' at bytes 235-236 and CUST-ADDR-ZIP '96003-5867' at bytes 240-249 of its 500-byte CVCUS01Y record. 'AP' is absent from the 56-literal VALID-US-STATE-CODE list, yet the probe its zip produces, 'AP96', IS present in the 240-literal VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO list: the APO and FPO military prefixes reached the combo table and never reached the state table, in the same copybook. Because the cross-field gate requires FLG-STATE-ISVALID, that valid combination is NEVER TESTED for this customer - the anomaly and the gate's suppressing effect are demonstrated by one expectation. Across all 50 customers, measured against the two correct tables, 45 states are in the 56-set and only 2 probes are in the 240-set, so the seeded production data fails the program's own combo edit almost universally; practice B5 requires the expectation to ENCODE that rather than avoid it. The other two shapes were re-derived and are recorded here rather than driven, because one screenRequest is one CICS turn and a turn carries one customer: customer 000000034 - row 33, ME with 49544-2869 giving probe ME49 - is the only fully clean row, both single-field edit and combo passing, and customer 000000001 - NC with 12546 giving probe NC12 - is the common shape, a valid state whose combo fails, which case11 already pins as the unavoidable consequence of its own seed. Customers 000000017 (FM, FM56) and 000000020 (MH, MH72, a five-digit zip space-padded to ten) fail both. A WIDTH MISMATCH PRESERVED, NOT FIXED (practice B5). The screen field is ACSZIPCI and ACSZIPCO PIC X(5) at app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY:246 and its output twin ACSZIPCO PIC X(5) at :572, while CUST-ADDR-ZIP is PIC X(10), and the fixtures hold ZIP+4 values such as 96003-5867 and 49544-2869. The screen is narrower by design and the DTO field is NOT widened to compensate. Three consequences follow, all of them asserted or stated: 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA :3875 stores the FULL ten bytes '96003-5867' in ACUP-OLD-CUST-ADDR-ZIP; 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES :2843 paints only '96003' because a ten-byte MOVE into a five-byte alphanumeric receiver truncates on the right; and 1100-RECEIVE-MAP :1354 pads that echo back out to '96003     ', so the round trip has silently dropped the +4 suffix. It does not change THIS edit's outcome, because 1280 reads only (1:2), but it does mean the comparison at :1745-1747 - FUNCTION TRIM of the new zip against FUNCTION TRIM of the old - can never be equal for a ZIP+4 customer. REACHING THE FIELD EDITS, AND THE ONE TYPED CHANGE. 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS :1429-1449 does not take the search-key path this time, so :1452-1457 SETs FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA, FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER, FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID, FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER and FLG-CUSTFILTER-ISVALID, and :1461-1462 performs 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW :1681-1777, whose NO-CHANGES-FOUND result would, at :1463-1468, MOVE LOW-VALUES TO WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS and GO TO the exit having edited nothing at all. The one field changed here is ACSADL2I, from the fixture's 'Apt. 328' to 'Apt. 329', and the choice is deliberate rather than convenient: Address Line 2 is the ONLY received item with no edit at all - :1613-1614 comments its variable name out and WS-EDIT-ADDRESS-LINE-2-FLGS keeps the space INITIALIZE WS-MISC-STORAGE left it, which is neither its NOT-OK '0' nor its BLANK 'B' - so it cannot pre-empt the state message under first-message-wins and cannot add a red field. Two source-grounded quirks would have reported a change even without it, and the order in which 1205 evaluates them is stated rather than glossed: the FIRST comparison block :1684-1704 already fails at the group-id arm, because AADDGRPI arrives as ten spaces, :1213-1218 turns SPACES into LOW-VALUES, and comparing that against ACUP-OLD-GROUP-ID's ten spaces through FUNCTION TRIM can never be equal - so CHANGE-HAS-OCCURRED is SET at :1703 and the GO TO at :1704 means the SECOND block, which is where the address-line-2 and zip comparisons live, is not reached on this turn at all. Everything else the screen sends back is the painted echo of the fetched copy, byte for byte, and the account id, monetary and date items round-trip exactly: the five monetary items are re-derived by :1106-1108 and its siblings through FUNCTION NUMVAL-C of the received text, so ACUP-NEW-CURR-BAL equals ACUP-OLD-CURR-BAL at scale 2, and :1051-1057 MOVEs ACCTSIDI into both CC-ACCT-ID and ACUP-NEW-ACCT-ID-X so the account-id arm matches too. EVERY EDIT AHEAD OF THE STATE WAS CHECKED, NOT ASSUMED, BECAUSE FIRST-MESSAGE-WINS MAKES ORDER DECISIVE. The order inside 1200 is account status, open date, credit limit, expiry date, cash credit limit, reissue date, current balance, current cycle credit, current cycle debit, SSN, date of birth, FICO score, first name, middle name, last name, address line 1, THEN state, then zip, city, country, phone 1, phone 2, EFT account id, primary card holder, and finally the cross-field gate. Account status 'Y' satisfies 1220-EDIT-YESNO. The account's three dates 2018-11-15, 2023-09-10 and 2023-09-10 and the date of birth 1987-03-25 clear EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD (app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy - century 19 or 20 only, month 1 through 12, day 1 through 31, the 31-day, February-30 and leap-year combination checks, then EDIT-DATE-LE which CALLs CSUTLDTC and accepts WS-SEVERITY-N = 0), and the birth date also clears EDIT-DATE-OF-BIRTH because 1987-03-25 precedes the pinned 2022-07-19. The five monetary items clear 1250-EDIT-SIGNED-9V2 :2180-2221, which tests FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL-C on the raw X(15) screen text - '+      2,903.00', '+      1,496.00', '+        144.00' and '+           .00' twice, each rendered by the same WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F PIC +ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99 mask at :371 that 3203 repaints them with. SSN 385 / 84 / 9271 clears 1265-EDIT-US-SSN :2431-2489 including INVALID-SSN-PART1, which rejects 000, 666 and 900 through 999 and 385 is none of them. FICO 340 clears 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD and then 1275-EDIT-FICO-SCORE, whose FICO-RANGE-IS-VALID is VALUES 300 THROUGH 850 - unlike case11, which had to change a 274 out of the way, this seed needs no help and the FICO field is echoed untouched. Emile, Jairo and White clear 1225-EDIT-ALPHA-REQD and 1235-EDIT-ALPHA-OPT; '133 Bergnaum Square' clears 1215-EDIT-MANDATORY, which only requires non-blank; and after the state, '96003' clears 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD at length 5 so FLG-ZIPCODE-ISVALID holds, 'Hansenville' and 'USA' clear 1225, phone 1's 303 / 654 / 3323 and phone 2's 520 / 186 / 2176 clear all three stages of 1260-EDIT-US-PHONE-NUM because both 303 and 520 are members of the 410-literal general-purpose set, '0086459831' clears 1245 at length 10, and 'Y' clears 1220. THE PATH. EIBCALEN is the full 1033 bytes COMMON-RETURN :1007-1019 returns - 160 for CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus 873 for WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA - and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is spaces rather than COMEN01C, so both disjuncts of the commarea gate at :880-882 are false and the ELSE at :887-893 restores both areas untouched. This is the turn immediately after the fetch-and-show turn for the same four seeded rows: ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION arrives as 'S' (ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS, :659) and ACUP-OLD-DETAILS holds exactly the snapshot 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA :3801-3883 left from them - ACUP-OLD-ACCT-ID-X 00000000018, ACUP-OLD-ACTIVE-STATUS Y, at scale exactly 2 ACUP-OLD-CURR-BAL-N 144.00, -CREDIT-LIMIT-N 2903.00, -CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-N 1496.00, -CURR-CYC-CREDIT-N 0.00 and -CURR-CYC-DEBIT-N 0.00, the compact eight-byte dates 20181115, 20230910, 20230910 and 19870325, ACUP-OLD-GROUP-ID at ten spaces, and ACUP-OLD-CUST-ADDR-ZIP at the full ten bytes 96003-5867. AID DFHENTER is PFK-VALID at :905-911. The order-sensitive EVALUATE TRUE at :921 lands on WHEN OTHER at :996 - PFK03 no, (ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED AND CDEMO-PGM-ENTER) no because the details ARE fetched and the context is REENTER, the LIT-MENUPGM arm no, OKAYED-AND-DONE and CHANGES-FAILED no - so 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION and 3000-SEND-MAP all run and the turn leaves by the forward-only GO TO COMMON-RETURN at :1003. :1470 SETs ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK ('E') before the field edits and :1671-1675 leaves it there because INPUT-ERROR is on, so 2000-DECIDE-ACTION :2562-2641 lands on WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK at :2596, which is CONTINUE - NOTHING IS READ on this turn, because 9000-READ-ACCT lives only in the first two arms, and nothing is written, because 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING is reached only by the PF05 confirmation arm at :2602-2605. THE RESULTING FLAG STATE, ASSERTED EXPLICITLY, AND WHAT IT WOULD HAVE BEEN FOR THE OTHER TWO SHAPES. WS-EDIT-STATE-FLGS and WS-EDIT-ZIPCODE-FLGS are single bytes at :303-310 whose 88s are ISVALID at LOW-VALUES, NOT-OK at '0' and BLANK at 'B'. On this turn: FLG-STATE-NOT-OK is SET by 1270 - not by 1280 - so the state byte is '0'; FLG-ZIPCODE-ISVALID still holds at LOW-VALUES because 1245 accepted 96003 and nothing later touched it; and 1280 DID NOT RUN AT ALL, so AP96 was never tested and no second message and no second red field exist. Had the driven row been customer 000000034, both bytes would have stayed at LOW-VALUES, 1280 WOULD have run and ME49 would have passed, leaving INPUT-ERROR off and 1200 SETting ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED at :1674. Had it been customer 000000001, the state edit would have passed, 1280 would have run and NC12 would have failed, SETting BOTH FLG-STATE-NOT-OK and FLG-ZIPCODE-NOT-OK to '0' and reddening both fields - which is precisely what case11 records as the consequence its own seed forces. THE SCREEN IS PAINTED FROM WHAT THE USER TYPED, NOT FROM THE FETCHED COPY. 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS :2698-2727 takes the ELSE because the context is REENTER, MOVEs CC-ACCT-ID into ACCTSIDO at :2707 because CC-ACCT-ID-N is not zero, and its EVALUATE at :2710-2724 lands on WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-MADE at :2718 - 'E' is in that condition's VALUES 'E', 'N', 'C', 'L', 'F' at :660-662 - so 3203-SHOW-UPDATED-VALUES :2870-2951 paints from ACUP-NEW-DETAILS and 3202-SHOW-ORIGINAL-VALUES is never performed. All 54 sent items are declared. Four of them are worth naming: ACSADL2O carries the typed 'Apt. 329' because :2934 moves ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-LINE-2; AADDGRPO is ten LOW-VALUES rather than ten spaces because :2921 moves ACUP-NEW-GROUP-ID, which :1215 set to LOW-VALUES when the received field was blank - invisible on a terminal and impossible to miss in a byte comparison; ACSZIPCO is the five-byte '96003' because :2937 moves a ten-byte item into a five-byte receiver; and ERRMSGO carries the composed state rejection, which 3250 writes rather than 3203. INFOMSGO is 'Update account details presented above.' padded to 45 because 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG :2955-2983 is also order-sensitive and its WHEN ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK arm at :2964 SETs PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES, the 88 on WS-INFO-MSG PIC X(40) at :470. FKEYSO, FKEY05O and FKEY12O are the mapset's own INITIAL text at app/bms/COACTUP.bms:497-507 and are never assigned by the program. TRNNAMEO, TITLE01O, PGMNAMEO, TITLE02O, CURDATEO and CURTIMEO come from 3100-SCREEN-INIT :2668-2692, with the two titles byte-exact from app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-22. THE ATTRIBUTE PLANE IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE ERROR-HIGHLIGHT MATRIX, AND ITS DIFFERENCE FROM case11 IS THE PROOF THE GATE WAS HONORED (gate G38). 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS :2986 does not leave early: the guard at :3186-3189 exits for ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK or FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and none holds, so all 39 CSSETATY expansions from :3208 run. Each is IF (FLG-x-NOT-OK OR FLG-x-BLANK) AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, MOVE DFHRED to the colour item and, ONLY when the flag is BLANK, MOVE '*' over the value (app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy:18-27). The context IS REENTER, so exactly ONE field turns red - ACSSTTEC, from FLG-STATE-NOT-OK. ACSZIPCC stays at the default DFHDFCOL that MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CACTUPAO at :2669 left, because 1280 never ran; in case11, where the state passed and the combo failed, BOTH went red. No '*' overlay is written anywhere, because no flag is at its BLANK value: this failure is a rejected value, not a missing one. ACCTSIDC also stays default - :3171 needs CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET to equal the card-list mapset and it is spaces, and :3176-3184 need the account filter to be NOT-OK or BLANK and it is ISVALID. INFOMSGH is bright DFHBMASB because 3390 :3566-3571 finds WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE false, and FKEY12H is bright too because :3573-3576 needs ACUP-CHANGES-MADE AND NOT ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE and 'E' satisfies both; FKEY05H stays hidden at DFHDFHI because :3578-3581 needs PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION and the information line holds the change prompt. The xxxA items 3310-PROTECT-ALL-ATTRS and 3320-UNPROTECT-FEW-ATTRS write are deliberately not declared: they belong to the input redefine CACTUPAI, not to the sent CACTUPAO. Attributes are metadata throughout and are never payload members. THE CURSOR GOES TO THE STATE FIELD FOR A DIFFERENT REASON THAN IT DID IN case11. The cursor EVALUATE at :3009-3167 is a second order-sensitive chain over the same flags, ordered by screen position rather than edit sequence. FOUND-ACCOUNT-DATA at :3010 is false - :1452 SET it, but 3250 then overwrote WS-INFO-MSG with the change prompt before 3300 ran; NO-CHANGES-DETECTED at :3011, an 88 on WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :491, is false because that field holds the state message; the two account-filter arms at :3013-3014 are false; and every arm from :3017 to :3119 is false because those flags are ISVALID. The first true arm is WHEN FLG-STATE-NOT-OK at :3121, which MOVEs -1 TO ACSSTTEL. The FLG-ZIPCODE arm at :3126 is next in line and is never reached - here because the state arm won and because the zip flag is ISVALID anyway, whereas in case11 the same arm was skipped only because the state arm won. COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into a symbolic-map length item, which is why the expectation names ACSSTTEL rather than a payload field. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37). No server-side session exists and none is needed. Inbound the payload carries the 1033-byte EIBCALEN, the AID, the sixteen CARDDEMO-COMMAREA fields of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy and the 43 received map items; outbound it carries the same sixteen navigation fields, unchanged, because nothing on this path writes a CDEMO- item - only the PF03 arm at :944-950 does that - plus nextProgram COACTUPC, nextMapset COACTUP and nextMap CACTUPA from :1031-1033 and 3400-SEND-SCREEN :3589-3592, and termination RETURN_TRANSID from the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID at :1015-1019 rather than XCTL, the program's only XCTL being in the PF03 arm at :956-959. ONE MODELLING LIMIT IS RECORDED RATHER THAN WORKED AROUND: the inbound 873-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA - ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION 'S' and the ACUP-OLD-DETAILS snapshot - cannot be expressed in screenRequest.commarea, whose keys must be CDEMO- or WS- names, because its items are ACUP- prefixed. It is therefore stated above in prose and is fully determined by the four seeded rows plus 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA. NOTHING IS READ, NOTHING IS WRITTEN, AND BOTH ARE POSITIVE ASSERTIONS. expectedWrites is empty: COACTUPC's only write verbs are the read-for-update and REWRITE pairs inside 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING :3888-4105, which only the PF05 arm reaches. Each of the four seeded rows is pinned unchanged on the final-state channel - field by field for the cross-reference, the account and the customer, and as a whole 150-byte image for the card - so a stray write would fail on both the field names and the total width. The customer row still holds 'Apt. 328' while the screen shows 'Apt. 329', and that divergence is the assertion that the typed change reached the screen and not the dataset. Every seeded row is a measured fact: acctdata.txt row 17 is account 00000000018, custdata.txt row 17 is customer 000000018, and cardxref.txt row 23 and carddata.txt row 23 are that account's cross-reference and card, card number 5671184478505844. cardxref.txt is seeded RAW at 36 bytes and is NOT pre-padded - CVACT03Y declares 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER X(14) - so the declared CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation supplies the fourteen spaces once, at seed time, and the final-state image is asserted at the copybook's 50 (gate G16, risk R-F). The four expectedDatasets entries pin the row count and the record length of each dataset at 50, 300, 500 and 150. RETURN CODE 0: the identifier RETURN-CODE does not occur anywhere in COACTUPC's 4,236 lines, because the program is pseudo-conversational and ends at EXEC CICS RETURN. THE MESSAGE CHANNEL IS SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 AND THE CHOICE IS DELIBERATE: COACTUPC contains zero DISPLAY statements, so it emits no console line at all; what it produces is the 78-byte ERRMSGO the symbolic map declares at app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY:650, which is exactly what that channel names and fixes the width of. 3250 MOVEs WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) into it, and :876 SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF had already left that field at spaces, so the value is the 32-character message followed by 46 spaces. The one expected message is byte-identical to the ERRMSGO pinned in the send, and the two are cross-checks on each other rather than two spellings of one guess. There is exactly ONE message because every write in this program is wrapped in IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF - first-message-wins - and the state edit is the first edit this seed fails. GATES. G15 and G16 by construction. G18 - the diff count must be zero across every one of the 54 screen items, all 108 attribute items, the cursor, the sixteen-field navigation image and the four record images. G30 - the cross-field gate at :1664-1669 and the source WHEN order of the EVALUATEs at :921, :2562, :2710, :2956 and :3008, three of which are decided here by arms that are not the first. G37 and G38 as set out above. G51 - unitKind CONTROLLER_POJO: account.AccountUpdateController is constructed directly with a real account.AreaCodeLookup, which owns all three CSLKPCDY phone tables and both state tables, and with fixture-backed repositories, and its handler is called as a plain method - no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path. TWO GATES ARE NOT APPLICABLE AND ARE RECORDED AS SUCH RATHER THAN SILENTLY SKIPPED. G32 does not apply: COACTUPC's GO TOs all target an -EXIT label, COMMON-RETURN or a forward stage - the one at :2508 in 1270 and the one at :2555 in 1280 among them - and CBSTM03A is the only program in this migration whose GO TOs form implicit loops. G35 does not apply: CALL 'CEE3ABD' occurs zero times in COACTUPC, all nine sites being in batch programs, and the EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999') in ABEND-ROUTINE is unreachable on a path that performs no file operation at all. PROVENANCE (practice B12). Every expected value above was derived STATICALLY. Set membership was RE-DERIVED by reading app/cpy/CSLKPCDY.cpy:1012-1318 and extracting the 56 state literals and the 240 state-plus-first-two-of-zip literals, and the state code and zip were obtained by DECODING app/data/ASCII/custdata.txt at CVCUS01Y's own offsets - bytes 235-236 and 240-249 of the 500-byte record - with the remaining customer, account, cross-reference and card values decoded the same way from custdata.txt, acctdata.txt, cardxref.txt and carddata.txt against CVCUS01Y 500, CVACT01Y 300, CVACT03Y 50 and CVACT02Y 150. The control flow was read from app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:296-310, :371, :411-416, :455-500, :640-849, :859-1035, :1039-1224, :1429-1476, :1529-1611, :1613-1676, :1681-1780, :1898-1955, :2109-2150, :2180-2223, :2431-2489, :2493-2511, :2535-2560, :2562-2641, :2660-2740, :2800-2951, :2955-2983, :2986-3167, :3186-3437, :3566-3592 and :3800-3883, from app/cpy/CSUTLDPY.cpy and CSUTLDWY.cpy for the date edits and app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy:17-27 for the highlight rule, with every width cross-checked against the xxxI, xxxO and xxxL PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and INITIAL text of app/bms/COACTUP.bms, and the commarea layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy. It was NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing it is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository - and this static derivation is the recorded substitute for an execution baseline, escalated as risk R-A in the plan's section 0.7.6 rather than silently absorbed. AUTHORING NOTES. No user-specified rule governs this fixture: review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided', so none is cited, none has been invented, and the absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar - enterprise best practice governs instead. B1, this case's distinct subject is the state-code table and the state-plus-zip2 combo table, with the phone area-code lookup left to case11 and no placeholder anywhere. B3, the COBOL, copybook, BMS, CSD and data trees are read-only; the fixtures were decoded, never edited. B5, the near-universal combo failure in the seed, the AP-versus-AP96 inconsistency between two tables in one copybook, the narrower ACSZIPCI X(5) screen field and the AADDGRPO LOW-VALUES quirk are all EXPECTED here, not corrected. B7, the clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:15:59, this source revision's own timestamp, so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are fixed literals no wall clock can reach, and every collection is ordered. B8, the charset is named US-ASCII explicitly and is never the platform default, and every expectation is an explicit field-to-value pair. B11, every width comes from a PICTURE clause rather than from a count of the characters that happen to be present - ACSSTTE X(2), ACSZIPC X(5), US-STATE-AND-FIRST-ZIP2 X(4), LAST-3-OF-ZIP X(3), CUST-ADDR-ZIP X(10), ERRMSG X(78) at COACTUP.CPY:650, INFOMSG X(45) at :644.
